g.text: Eight swim-lane sequences: 1·Session Viewer 2·Memory Browser 3·Approval Workflow 4·Cost Tracking 5·Calendar Workspace 6·SSE Streaming (NEW) 7·Ingestion Event Viewer (NEW) 8·Model Settings (NEW)
Detail: GET /api/sessions/{id} → global fan-out: sessions + session_process_logs
Gracefully skips pools missing memory tables; PATCH /api/memory/entities/{id} writes entity fields
Decide: POST /api/approvals/{id}/approve|reject → UPDATE pending_actions + broadcast SSE; Rules CRUD: /api/approvals/rules
Estimates cost via pricing.toml (estimate_session_cost); fan-out to all butler MCP clients concurrently
POST /sync triggers MCP sync across butlers; PATCH sets primary calendar; stale threshold = 10 min
Events: connected · butler_status · session_start · session_end; broadcast() called by other routers; keepalive comment every 30 s
Merges shared.ingestion_events + connectors.filtered_events; /{id}/rollup → fan-out sessions + pricing; POST /{id}/replay → UPDATE filtered_events
CRUD: POST (201) / PUT /{id} / DELETE /{id}; overrides: GET|PUT /api/butlers/{name}/model-overrides;
Source: src/butlers/api/routers/ · Auto-discovered by router_discovery.py · All DB queries use asyncpg pools via DatabaseManager
